SELECT
DATE_FORMAT(created_time, '%Y-%m-%d') as time_label,
CONCAT(YEAR(created_time), '-W', WEEK(created_time)) as time_label,
DATE_FORMAT(created_time, '%Y-%m') as time_label,
DATE_FORMAT(created_time, '%Y-%m-%d') as time_label,
SUM(amount) as rebate_amount, SUM(IF(status = 'SUCCESS', amount, 0)) as settled_amount, COUNT(id) as record_count FROM joint_marketing_rebate_record WHERE plan_id = #{dto.planId} AND created_time BETWEEN #{dto.startDate} AND #{dto.endDate}
AND (payer_merchant_id = #{dto.merchantId} OR payee_merchant_id = #{dto.merchantId})
GROUP BY time_label ORDER BY time_label

SELECT
DATE_FORMAT(created_time, '%Y-%m-%d') as time_period,
CONCAT(YEAR(created_time), '年第', WEEK(created_time), '周') as time_period,
DATE_FORMAT(created_time, '%Y-%m') as time_period,
CONCAT(YEAR(created_time), '年Q', QUARTER(created_time)) as time_period,
DATE_FORMAT(created_time, '%Y-%m-%d') as time_period,
COUNT(id) as total_records, SUM(amount) as total_amount, SUM(IF(status = 'SUCCESS', amount, 0)) as success_amount, SUM(IF(status = 'FAILED', amount, 0)) as failed_amount, SUM(IF(status = 'SUCCESS', 1, 0)) as success_records, SUM(IF(status = 'FAILED', 1, 0)) as failed_records, ROUND(SUM(IF(status = 'SUCCESS', 1, 0)) * 100.0 / COUNT(id), 2) as success_rate, -- 环比增长率计算 LAG(SUM(amount)) OVER (ORDER BY
DATE_FORMAT(created_time, '%Y-%m-%d')
CONCAT(YEAR(created_time), WEEK(created_time))
DATE_FORMAT(created_time, '%Y-%m')
CONCAT(YEAR(created_time), QUARTER(created_time))
) as previous_period_amount, IF(LAG(SUM(amount)) OVER (ORDER BY
DATE_FORMAT(created_time, '%Y-%m-%d')
CONCAT(YEAR(created_time), WEEK(created_time))
DATE_FORMAT(created_time, '%Y-%m')
CONCAT(YEAR(created_time), QUARTER(created_time))
) > 0, ROUND((SUM(amount) - LAG(SUM(amount)) OVER (ORDER BY
DATE_FORMAT(created_time, '%Y-%m-%d')
CONCAT(YEAR(created_time), WEEK(created_time))
DATE_FORMAT(created_time, '%Y-%m')
CONCAT(YEAR(created_time), QUARTER(created_time))
)) * 100.0 / LAG(SUM(amount)) OVER (ORDER BY
DATE_FORMAT(created_time, '%Y-%m-%d')
CONCAT(YEAR(created_time), WEEK(created_time))
DATE_FORMAT(created_time, '%Y-%m')
CONCAT(YEAR(created_time), QUARTER(created_time))
), 2), 0) as growth_rate FROM joint_marketing_rebate_record WHERE created_time BETWEEN #{dto.startDate} AND #{dto.endDate}
AND plan_id = #{dto.planId}
AND (payer_merchant_id = #{dto.merchantId} OR payee_merchant_id = #{dto.merchantId})
AND status = #{dto.status}
GROUP BY time_period ORDER BY time_period ASC
